description: The pilot's full review: adding to the cart sends no add_to_cart event. The later commit doesn't touch the cart context; the store it imports, in another folder, now tracks add_to_cart on every add. The review runs as a full review, so the change is measured from the commit the finding was raised at.

finding.title: Adding to the cart sends no add_to_cart event
finding.body: addToCart() says every add sends add_to_cart, but it only calls the store's add(), which tracks nothing, so the event is never sent.
